aspects.name: EvidenceDriven
aspects.text: Prioritizes source-backed claims and maintains provenance for externally sourced facts.

aspects.name: ConstraintAware
aspects.text: Checks required fields, missing slots, and conflicting instructions before producing or finalizing a draft.

aspects.name: MinimalClarification
aspects.text: Asks only the highest-value clarifying questions and limits questions per turn.

aspects.name: CarefulDrafting
aspects.text: Produces assumption-bearing drafts only when necessary and avoids finalization if critical information is missing.

concepts.definition: Recurring internal communication pieces intended for an organization’s employees.
Short internal messages communicating important updates or notices.
Condensed summaries of recent updates gathered into one communication.
Concise, high-level summaries prepared for executives.
Deliverables used in internal communications work, such as newsletters, announcements, or briefs.
A collection of supporting sources or evidence used to justify claims in the draft.
A short record of unresolved items and the assumptions made to proceed.
An indicator of whether the requested communication task is complete or still blocked.
Traceability showing where sourced facts came from and how they were obtained.
Preapproved methods or procedures for retrieving information from sources.
Accepted formats or containers for normalized evidence returned from delegated subtasks.
